FULL TEXT:
Walk-in Interview
Applications are invited for 02 (Two) post of Research Investigators for Two months, purely on
contract basis, in a Social Impact Assessment project entitled “Social Impact Assessment Study
for acquisition of land to construct LHS/RUB 2x5.50mx3.50m (shifted location) at KM 239/7-8 in
lieu of level crossing no. 123 C at KM 239/7-8 on UMB-CDG Railway line in village Raipur Kalan,
Hadbast No. 371, Chandigarh”. The interested candidates can attend the walk-in-interviews,
along with their detailed bio-data and attested copies of certificates and work experience, in the
office of the undersigned on 31st October, 2023 at 11.30 am
1. Research Investigators (02)-Two posts for 02 Months only
Essential qualifications:
i) M.A/M.Sc. in Anthropology or allied subjects with minimum 55% marks for General category
candidates (50% in case of SC/ST candidates).
ii) The age of candidate should be below 40 years
iii) Knowledge of Hindi language is must
iv) The candidate/s having fieldwork knowledge in the related subject will be given preference.
Desirable qualifications:
i) The candidate must be willing to conduct independent field work/data collection.
Emoluments: Rs. 36,000/- per month (consolidated)
No T.A./D.A. is permissible for appearing in the interview.
Note: Please check the university website before appearing for the interview. There might be
slight changes in the interview date.
Dr. JS Sehrawat
Assistant Professor
Department of Anthropology
Panjab University
Chandigarh-160014
